De publieke repository CreateWorkerAI/createworker-node (taal: TypeScript) had een commit op 2026-07-08. Omschrijving: “Official TypeScript/Node SDK for the CreateWorker API — create and run AI agents, read results, approve actions, verify webhooks.”.
